access.zh: z.ai / BigModel API（GLM-5.3 及更早）；GLM-5.4 已向 GLM Coding Plan 全量用户开放，可在常用工具中使用，公开 API 需等安全评估完成后开放，权重也计划在安全加固后开放，当前不可下载或本地部署。
access.en: z.ai / BigModel APIs (GLM-5.3 and earlier); GLM-5.4 is already available to all GLM Coding Plan users in supported tools, while the public API awaits safety assessment and weights are planned after safety hardening — no download or local deployment today.

currentGen.zh: GLM-5.4（750B 基座，官方称 2–3T 级智能）

generations.zh: 2026-11-23 发布：750B 基座，28 层循环两遍；泛 Coding（视频、游戏、3D）与原生多模态；已向 GLM Coding Plan 全量用户开放，公开 API 待安全评估，权重计划在安全加固后放。
generations.en: Announced 2026-11-23: 750B base with 28 layers looped twice; general coding (video, games, 3D) and native multimodality; available to all GLM Coding Plan users, with the public API awaiting safety assessment and weights planned after safety hardening.

generations.zh: 上一代开放权重旗舰：754B MoE（激活数未公开）+ 321B Flash 杯；官方自评“开放权重里编码最强”，属厂商自评基准。
generations.en: Previous open-weight flagship: 754B MoE (activation undisclosed) plus a 321B Flash tier; officially billed as the strongest open-weights coder, a vendor-run benchmark.

generations.zh: 本代起点与中期迭代；5.2 是 5.3 官方改进幅度的对照。
generations.en: Generation opener and mid-cycle refresh; 5.2 is the reference point for the official 5.3 improvement claim.

v.zh: 750B 基座；28 层循环两遍；官方称智能达到 2–3T 级参数模型水平。
v.en: 750B base; 28 layers looped twice; vendor claims intelligence on par with 2–3T-class models.

v.zh: 泛 Coding 覆盖视频、游戏与 3D；原生多模态；不是只做代码补全的专用模型。
v.en: General coding spans video, games and 3D; native multimodality; not a code-completion-only model.

v.zh: GLM Coding Plan 全量用户已可在常用工具中使用 GLM-5.4（有周限额用户额度提升至 GLM-5.3 的 1.5 倍）；公开 API 将在安全评估完成后开放；权重计划在安全加固后开放，当前不可下载。
v.en: All GLM Coding Plan users can already use GLM-5.4 in supported tools (weekly-quota users get 1.5x the GLM-5.3 allowance); the public API opens after safety assessment; weights are planned after safety hardening and are not downloadable today.

positioning.zh: GLM-5.4 是闭源首发、开放权重待定的过渡代。Coding Plan 用户现在能在工具里用上，公开 API 与权重还要等；要本地跑仍看 5.3 与 MIT 的 Flash 杯。
positioning.en: GLM-5.4 is a closed-first release with open weights pending. Coding Plan users can use it in supported tools now, while the public API and weights are still pending; for local deployment, still use 5.3 and the MIT-licensed Flash tier.

onSite.zh: 开放权重侧的 glm-5 谱系仍跟到 GLM-5.3（含量化对比）；5.4 先记在闭源卡与 2026 增补页。
onSite.en: The open-weight glm-5 family card still tracks GLM-5.3 (with quantisation comparison); 5.4 is recorded here and on the 2026 supplement page.
